verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a REST API for submitting order/checkout/chargeback data into Signifyd and retrieving decisions, but nothing indicates a full data-export capability or open-format bulk export/portability feature for users to take all their data and leave. No mention of GDPR-style export, data portability tooling, or account deletion/export flows. missing for 10: bulk/full data export feature, open-format (CSV/JSON) export documentation, account closure/data portability guarantee.
